Description: Termination arbitration code.

Label: Idb Tsev1
Description: A code indicating the severity associated with TTITLE1.

Label: Idb Tsev2
Description: A code indicating the severity associated with TTITLE2.

Label: Idb Tsev3
Description: A code indicating the severity associated with TTITLE3.

Label: Idb Tsev4
Description: A code indicating the severity associated with TTITLE4.

Label: Idb Tsev5
Description: A code indicating the severity associated with TTITLE5.

Label: Idb Ttitle1
Description: The title and section of the U.S. Code applicable to the offense that carried the most severe disposition and penalty under which the defendant was disposed.

Label: Idb Ttitle2
Description: The title and section of the U.S. Code applicable to the offense under which the defendant was disposed that carried the second most severe disposition and penalty.

Label: Idb Ttitle3
Description: The title and section of the U.S. Code applicable to the offense under which the defendant was disposed that carried the third most severe disposition and penalty.

Label: Idb Ttitle4
Description: The title and section of the U.S. Code applicable to the offense under which the defendant was disposed that carried the fourth most severe disposition and penalty.

Label: Idb Ttitle5
Description: The title and section of the U.S. Code applicable to the offense under which the defendant was disposed that carried the fifth most severe disposition and penalty.

Label: Idb Typemag
Description: Case type associated with a magistrate case if the current case was merged from a magistrate case.

Label: Idb Typereg
Description: Case type associated with the current defendant record.

Label: Idb Typetrn
Description: Case type associated with the originating case if the current case was a transfer.

Label: Idb Update
Description: The date of the last action taken on the record.

Label: Idb Ver
Description: A sequential number indicating the iteration of the defendant record.

Label: Ifp Judge Attribution
Description: The judge presiding over a case at the time a given docket entry was entered on a docket sheet that includes "in forma pauperis" (IFP) activity.

Label: Ifp Label
Description: A SCALES IFP label (application, grant, deny, other) that applies to a given docket entry on a docket sheet that includes "in forma pauperis" (IFP) activity.

Label: Intersecting Neighborhood
Description: A city neighborhood whose boundaries intersect with those of a given area.

Label: Law Firm
Description: A law firm or other office offering legal services.

Label: Member Case
Description: In multi-district litigation (MDL), a case listed in the "PACER Member Cases" header section on the docket sheet for a given lead case.

Label: NAICSCode
Description: A North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code corresponding to the given company.

Label: Ontology Label
Description: An event label or attribute label from the SCALES Litigation Ontology that applies to a given docket entry.

Label: Party
Description: A party to a court case.

Label: Political Party Of Appointing President
Description: The political party to which the US president belonged when they appointed a given judge.

Label: Reference To Other Entry
Description: A hyperlink to another docket entry within the text of a given PACER docket entry.

Label: Related Case
Description: A case listed in the PACER "Related Cases" header section on the docket sheet for a given case.

Label: SICCode
Description: A Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) code corresponding to the given company.

Label: UVAJudge Dir ID
Description: A unique ID that specifies a judge in the University of Virginia's directory of bankruptcy and magistrate judges.

Label: Unparsed Sentence Text
Description: Any text in a given sentence description that SCALES could not parse.

Label: Administrative Region 2
Description: A level-2 KnowWhereGraph region, denoting a county, district, or equivalent administrative area.
